name: omnisaude
description: OmniSaúde: gestão integrada de redes públicas de saúde (APS, urgência e hospital) com IA, interoperabilidade RNDS e faturamento SUS.

scripts.build:libs: npm run generate -w @omnisaude/database && tsc -b packages/shared packages/database packages/ai-engine packages/messaging packages/fhir packages/accessibility
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @omnisaude/api && npm run build -w @omnisaude/mocks && npm run build -w @omnisaude/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/database packages/ai-engine packages/messaging packages/fhir packages/accessibility apps/api infra/mocks && npm run typecheck -w @omnisaude/web
